mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_ROLE r WHERE r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.sort_ord, r.role_id
SELECT FROM TB_SY_ROLE r WHERE r.role_id=#{id}

SELECT a.menu_id, m.menu_nm, COALESCE(g.menu_nm,'') AS group_name, a.inq_yn, a.reg_yn, a.upd_yn, a.del_yn, a.upld_yn, a.dnld_yn, a.cnfm_yn FROM TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH a JOIN TB_SY_MENU m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id LEFT JOIN TB_SY_MENU g ON g.menu_id=m.upper_menu_id WHERE a.role_id=#{id} AND m.scrn_id IS NOT NULL AND m.use_yn='Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_MENU child WHERE child.upper_menu_id=m.menu_id) ORDER BY g.sort_ord NULLS FIRST, g.menu_id, m.sort_ord, m.menu_id
SELECT c.code, c.code_nm FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.code_grp_id='DATA_SCOPE' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND c.code IN ('ALL','PART','PROJ') ORDER BY c.sort_ord, c.code
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_ROLE r WHERE r.role_nm=#{name})

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(substring(issued.id FROM 3)::numeric),0) FROM ( SELECT r.role_id AS id FROM TB_SY_ROLE r UNION ALL SELECT h.trgt_key AS id FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_ROLE' ) issued WHERE issued.id ~ '^R-[0-9]+$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH (role_id,menu_id,inq_yn,reg_yn,upd_yn,del_yn,upld_yn, dnld_yn,cnfm_yn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) SELECT #{id},a.menu_id,a.inq_yn,a.reg_yn,a.upd_yn,a.del_yn,a.upld_yn,a.dnld_yn,a.cnfm_yn, 'admin',clock_timestamp() FROM TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH a WHERE a.role_id=#{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH SET inq_yn=#{input.readYn},reg_yn=#{input.createYn}, upd_yn=#{input.updateYn},del_yn=#{input.deleteYn},upld_yn=#{input.uploadYn}, dnld_yn=#{input.downloadYn},cnfm_yn=#{input.cnfmYn},mod_user_id='admin',mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE role_id=#{id} AND menu_id=#{input.menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur WHERE ur.role_id=#{id}

SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s WHERE s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.proj_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur WHERE ur.user_id=s.user_id AND ur.role_id=#{id}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE pm WHERE pm.user_id=s.user_id AND pm.role_id='PM') ORDER BY s.user_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_sn=#{scopeSn}
